general.title: General Settings
general.name: Camera Name
general.urlDescription: RTSP, HTTP, or local device URL

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Enable/disable alerts and detections for this camera. When disabled, no new review items will be generated.

classification.title: Review Classification
classification.description: Frigate categorizes review items as Alerts and Detections. By default, all person and car objects are considered Alerts. You can refine categorization of your review items by configuring required zones for them.
classification.noZones: No zones are defined for this camera.
classification.alertsInfo: All person, car objects on {{camera}} will be shown as Alerts.
classification.detectionsInfo: All objects not classified as Alerts on {{camera}} will be shown as Detections, regardless of zone.

semantic.title: Semantic Search
semantic.description: Semantic Search in Frigate allows you to find tracked objects within your review items using either the image itself, a user-defined text description, or an automatically generated one.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable semantic search functionality.

reindex.title: Re-Index On Startup
reindex.description: Re-indexing will reprocess all thumbnails and descriptions (if enabled) on startup.

model.title: Model Size
model.description: The size of the model used for Semantic Search embeddings.

small.title: Small
small.description: Using small employs a quantized version of the model that uses less RAM and runs faster on CPU with a very negligible difference in embedding quality.

large.title: Large
large.description: Using large employs the full Jina model and will automatically run on the GPU if applicable.

motion.title: Motion Tuner
motion.description: Adjust motion detection settings for optimal performance

threshold.title: Motion Threshold
threshold.description: Minimum pixel difference to trigger motion detection

masks.title: Masks
masks.description: Define areas to ignore in detection

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Define areas of interest for detection

debug.title: Debug Settings
debug.description: Advanced settings for troubleshooting and debugging

retention.title: Log Retention
retention.description: Number of days to keep logs
